_read_this: Pinned claims for the protected Lean stack. A theorem is pinned by its STATEMENT (through the first `:=`), a definition by its BODY; whitespace is collapsed and comments stripped, so a reformatted proof is free and a reworded claim is not. `pins` is enforced by scripts/lean_lint.py with no toolchain. `elab` holds the #check type and #print axioms output and is enforced by the lake-build job, which can run a toolchain. Weakening, renaming away, or deleting an entry here is not a way to pass CI: the key set is derived from REQUIRED|PROTECTED in lean_lint.py. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/pin_statements.py --write`; the diff is the audit trail, and it must be read before it is committed.

BSM.Phi_eq_integral_Iic.type: BSM.Phi_eq_integral_Iic : ∀ (x : ℝ), BSM.Phi x = ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Iic x, BSM.phi u

BSM.Phi_le_exp_mul_Phi_add.type: BSM.Phi_le_exp_mul_Phi_add : ∀ (x a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → BSM.Phi x ≤ Real.exp (a * x + a ^ 2 / 2) * BSM.Phi (x + a)

BSM.bsCall_nonneg.type: BSM.bsCall_nonneg : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), 0 < S → 0 < K → 0 < tau → 0 < sigma → 0 ≤ BSM.bsCall S K tau r q sigma

BSM.d1.type: BSM.d1 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

BSM.d1_exponent.type: BSM.d1_exponent : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), 0 < tau → sigma ≠ 0 → sigma * √tau * BSM.d1 S K tau r q sigma - (sigma * √tau) ^ 2 / 2 = Real.log (S / K) + (r - q) * tau

BSM.forward_eq.type: BSM.forward_eq : ∀ (S K tau r q : ℝ), 0 < S → 0 < K → K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * Real.exp (Real.log (S / K) + (r - q) * tau) = S * Real.exp (-q * tau)

BSM.integral_phi_Iic_zero.type: BSM.integral_phi_Iic_zero : ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Iic 0, BSM.phi u = 1 / 2

BSM.no_drift_makes_spot_integrable.type: BSM.no_drift_makes_spot_integrable : ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ S₀ d : ℝ), 0 < S₀ → 0 < c → (∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) → ¬MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => S₀ * Real.exp (x + d)) μ

BSM.ofReal_mul_tail_le_lintegral_exp_add.type: BSM.ofReal_mul_tail_le_lintegral_exp_add : ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) (d α c x : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x) → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (x + d) * (c * x ^ (-α))) ≤ ∫⁻ (y : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (y + d)) ∂μ

BSM.phi_add.type: BSM.phi_add : ∀ (u a : ℝ), Real.exp (a * u + a ^ 2 / 2) * BSM.phi (u + a) = BSM.phi u

BSM.spot_not_integrable_of_tail_lower_bo.type: BSM.spot_not_integrable_of_tail_lower_bound : ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ S₀ : ℝ), 0 < S₀ → 0 < c → (∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) → ¬MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => S₀ * Real.exp x) μ

BSM.t1_d1_minus_d2.type: BSM.t1_d1_minus_d2 : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), 0 < tau → sigma ≠ 0 → BSM.d1 S K tau r q sigma - BSM.d2 S K tau r q sigma = sigma * √tau

BSM.t2_put_call_parity.type: BSM.t2_put_call_parity : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), BSM.bsPut S K tau r q sigma = BSM.bsCall S K tau r q sigma - S * Real.exp (-q * tau) + K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t2_put_call_parity_spread.type: BSM.t2_put_call_parity_spread : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), BSM.bsCall S K tau r q sigma - BSM.bsPut S K tau r q sigma = S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t3_delta_identity.type: BSM.t3_delta_identity : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), 0 < S → 0 < K → 0 < tau → sigma ≠ 0 → S * Real.exp (-q * tau) * BSM.phi (BSM.d1 S K tau r q sigma) = K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * BSM.phi (BSM.d2 S K tau r q sigma)

BSM.t4_call_bounds.type: BSM.t4_call_bounds : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), 0 < S → 0 < K → 0 < tau → 0 < sigma → max (S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)) 0 ≤ BSM.bsCall S K tau r q sigma ∧ BSM.bsCall S K tau r q sigma ≤ S * Real.exp (-q * tau)

BSM.t4_put_bounds.type: BSM.t4_put_bounds : ∀ (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ), 0 < S → 0 < K → 0 < tau → 0 < sigma → max (K * Real.exp (-r * tau) - S * Real.exp (-q * tau)) 0 ≤ BSM.bsPut S K tau r q sigma ∧ BSM.bsPut S K tau r q sigma ≤ K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.Phi.pin: def Phi (x : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 + erf (x / Real.sqrt 2)) / 2

BSM.Phi_add_Phi_neg.pin: theorem Phi_add_Phi_neg (x : ℝ) : Phi x + Phi (-x) = 1

BSM.Phi_eq_integral_Iic.pin: theorem Phi_eq_integral_Iic (x : ℝ) : Phi x = ∫ u in Set.Iic x, phi u

BSM.Phi_le_exp_mul_Phi_add.pin: theorem Phi_le_exp_mul_Phi_add (x a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : Phi x ≤ Real.exp (a * x + a ^ 2 / 2) * Phi (x + a)

BSM.Phi_neg.pin: theorem Phi_neg (x : ℝ) : Phi (-x) = 1 - Phi x

BSM.bsCall.pin: def bsCall (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : ℝ := S * Real.exp (-q * tau) * Phi (d1 S K tau r q sigma) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * Phi (d2 S K tau r q sigma)

BSM.bsCall_nonneg.pin: theorem bsCall_nonneg (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : 0 ≤ bsCall S K tau r q sigma

BSM.bsPut.pin: def bsPut (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : ℝ := K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * Phi (-(d2 S K tau r q sigma)) - S * Real.exp (-q * tau) * Phi (-(d1 S K tau r q sigma))

BSM.bsPut_nonneg.pin: theorem bsPut_nonneg (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : 0 ≤ bsPut S K tau r q sigma

BSM.carrMadanKernel.pin: def carrMadanKernel (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (α : ℝ) (u : ℝ) : ℂ := φ (↑u + ↑α * Complex.I) * (cmDenom α u)⁻¹

BSM.carrMadanKernel_integrable.pin: theorem carrMadanKernel_integrable {φ : ℂ → ℂ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hcont : Continuous fun u : ℝ => φ (↑u + ↑α * Complex.I)) {c D Y : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hY : 0 < Y) {u₀ : ℝ} (hdecay : ∀ u : ℝ, u₀ ≤ |u| → ‖φ (↑u + ↑α * Complex.I)‖ ≤ D * Real.exp (-c * |u| ^ Y)) : Integrable (carrMadanKernel φ α) volume

BSM.carrMadanPhase.pin: def carrMadanPhase (tau u : ℝ) : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(u * tau))

BSM.carrMadan_price_integrable.pin: theorem carrMadan_price_integrable {φ : ℂ → ℂ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hcont : Continuous fun u : ℝ => φ (↑u + ↑α * Complex.I)) {c D Y : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hY : 0 < Y) {u₀ : ℝ} (hdecay : ∀ u : ℝ, u₀ ≤ |u| → ‖φ (↑u + ↑α * Complex.I)‖ ≤ D * Real.exp (-c * |u| ^ Y)) (r tau : ℝ) : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-r * tau) / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (carrMadanPhase tau u * carrMadanKernel φ α u)) volume

BSM.cmDenom.pin: def cmDenom (α u : ℝ) : ℂ := ↑(α ^ 2 + α - u ^ 2) + ↑((2 * α + 1) * u) * Complex.I

BSM.cmDenom_ne_zero.pin: theorem cmDenom_ne_zero (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (u : ℝ) : cmDenom α u ≠ 0

BSM.cmDenom_u4_le.pin: theorem cmDenom_u4_le (α u : ℝ) : u ^ 4 ≤ (α ^ 2 + α - u ^ 2) ^ 2 + ((2 * α + 1) * u) ^ 2

BSM.d1.pin: def d1 (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.log (S / K) + (r - q + sigma ^ 2 / 2) * tau) / (sigma * Real.sqrt tau)

BSM.d1_exponent.pin: theorem d1_exponent (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : sigma * Real.sqrt tau * d1 S K tau r q sigma - (sigma * Real.sqrt tau) ^ 2 / 2 = Real.log (S / K) + (r - q) * tau

BSM.d2.pin: def d2 (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.log (S / K) + (r - q - sigma ^ 2 / 2) * tau) / (sigma * Real.sqrt tau)

BSM.d2_exponent.pin: theorem d2_exponent (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : sigma * Real.sqrt tau * d2 S K tau r q sigma + (sigma * Real.sqrt tau) ^ 2 / 2 = Real.log (S / K) + (r - q) * tau

BSM.erf.pin: noncomputable def erf (x : ℝ) : ℝ := (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t ^ 2))

BSM.exp_moment_infinite_add_of_tail_lowe.pin: theorem exp_moment_infinite_add_of_tail_lower_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ d : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (htail : ∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ¬ Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (y + d)) μ

BSM.exp_moment_infinite_of_tail_lower_bo.pin: theorem exp_moment_infinite_of_tail_lower_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (htail : ∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ¬ Integrable (fun y => Real.exp y) μ

BSM.forward_eq.pin: theorem forward_eq (S K tau r q : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) : K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * Real.exp (Real.log (S / K) + (r - q) * tau) = S * Real.exp (-q * tau)

BSM.gbmCharFactor.pin: def gbmCharFactor (m s : ℝ) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑m * v - ↑s * v ^ 2)

BSM.gbm_carrMadanKernel_integrable.pin: theorem gbm_carrMadanKernel_integrable (m s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) : Integrable (carrMadanKernel (gbmCharFactor m s) α) volume

BSM.gbm_carrMadan_price_integrable.pin: theorem gbm_carrMadan_price_integrable (m s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (r tau : ℝ) : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-r * tau) / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (carrMadanPhase tau u * carrMadanKernel (gbmCharFactor m s) α u)) volume

BSM.integrable_exp_neg_abs_rpow.pin: theorem integrable_exp_neg_abs_rpow {c Y : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hY : 0 < Y) : Integrable fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-c * |u| ^ Y)

BSM.integral_phi_Iic_zero.pin: theorem integral_phi_Iic_zero : ∫ u in Set.Iic (0:ℝ), phi u = 1 / 2

BSM.lintegral_exp_add_eq_top_of_tail_low.pin: theorem lintegral_exp_add_eq_top_of_tail_lower_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ d : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (htail : ∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (y + d)) ∂μ = ⊤

BSM.lintegral_exp_eq_top_of_tail_lower_b.pin: theorem lintegral_exp_eq_top_of_tail_lower_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (htail : ∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp y) ∂μ = ⊤

BSM.no_drift_makes_spot_integrable.pin: theorem no_drift_makes_spot_integrable (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ S₀ d : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S₀) (hc : 0 < c) (htail : ∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ¬ Integrable (fun x => S₀ * Real.exp (x + d)) μ

BSM.ofReal_mul_tail_le_lintegral_exp_add.pin: theorem ofReal_mul_tail_le_lintegral_exp_add (μ : Measure ℝ) (d α c x : ℝ) (htail : ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (x + d) * (c * x ^ (-α))) ≤ ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (y + d)) ∂μ

BSM.phi.pin: def phi (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)

BSM.phi_add.pin: theorem phi_add (u a : ℝ) : Real.exp (a * u + a ^ 2 / 2) * phi (u + a) = phi u

BSM.phi_neg.pin: theorem phi_neg (x : ℝ) : phi (-x) = phi x

BSM.spot_not_integrable_of_tail_lower_bo.pin: theorem spot_not_integrable_of_tail_lower_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ S₀ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S₀) (hc : 0 < c) (htail : ∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ¬ Integrable (fun x => S₀ * Real.exp x) μ

BSM.t1_d1_minus_d2.pin: theorem t1_d1_minus_d2 (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : d1 S K tau r q sigma - d2 S K tau r q sigma = sigma * Real.sqrt tau

BSM.t2_put_call_parity.pin: theorem t2_put_call_parity (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : bsPut S K tau r q sigma = bsCall S K tau r q sigma - S * Real.exp (-q * tau) + K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t2_put_call_parity_spread.pin: theorem t2_put_call_parity_spread (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : bsCall S K tau r q sigma - bsPut S K tau r q sigma = S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t3_delta_identity.pin: theorem t3_delta_identity (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : S * Real.exp (-q * tau) * phi (d1 S K tau r q sigma) = K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * phi (d2 S K tau r q sigma)

BSM.t4_call_bounds.pin: theorem t4_call_bounds (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : max (S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)) 0 ≤ bsCall S K tau r q sigma ∧ bsCall S K tau r q sigma ≤ S * Real.exp (-q * tau)

BSM.t4_put_bounds.pin: theorem t4_put_bounds (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : max (K * Real.exp (-r * tau) - S * Real.exp (-q * tau)) 0 ≤ bsPut S K tau r q sigma ∧ bsPut S K tau r q sigma ≤ K * Real.exp (-r * tau)
